## Henry David Thoreau on simplicity

Henry David Thoreau (1817–1862) approaches simplicity within Transcendentalism. Simplify needs to recover awake life; most luxuries are hindrances. Conscience outranks majority law when the state abets slavery or aggressive war. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets simplicity most directly—useful for searches such as “henry david thoreau quotes on simplicity.”
